current_scope.purpose: Public minimized IPR registry reference for R&D documentation, hash-only proof commitments, audit-trail continuity, and deterministic verification review.
current_scope.public_position: This registry is an R&D reference surface. It is not a public authority identity registry, not a regulated certification register, not an eIDAS qualified trust service, not a custodial identity service, and not a production compliance framework by itself.
current_scope.operational_boundary: Public IPR entries are minimized proof references. They do not expose private identity evidence, raw personal identifiers, identity documents, credentials, secrets, private keys, production logs, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, client files, or sensitive operational payloads.

rules.public_ipr_interpretation: A public IPR entry proves only that a public hash reference exists. It does not certify legal identity, public authority approval, regulated compliance, cybersecurity assurance, institutional mandate, operational activation, or production authorization.
rules.production_interpretation: R&D and public proof entries must not be interpreted as regulated certification, public authority approval, or production compliance validity unless independently supported by a lawful production framework.

privacy_note: This public IPR registry must not store private identity evidence, identity documents, raw personal identifiers, credentials, secrets, private keys, production logs, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, client files, regulated identity documents, financial assets, confidential payloads, or sensitive operational material. Public IPR records should be represented only through minimized metadata and hash-only public proof commitments.
empty_registry_interpretation: An empty entries array means no public IPR proof entries are currently available in this registry file. It does not certify absence of activity, validity, authorization, identity status, compliance status, security status, or operational activation by itself.

constraints.ipr_label: Public minimal label only; must not contain raw personal identifiers, private evidence, identity documents, secrets, credentials, client data, or internal endpoints.
constraints.timestamp: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 parseable timestamp with timezone when available

verification.fail_closed_rule: Missing, malformed, ambiguous, placeholder-based, or inconsistent registry state must not produce VALID.
verification.production_rule: RND_ONLY and RETAINED statuses must not be interpreted as regulated certification, public authority approval, production compliance validity, cybersecurity assurance, legal identity certification, or operational authorization.
